title: working-capital loan list row identity (account and client)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture loans-list-raw.json (GET /working-capital-loans, tenant gerege). The pinned capture holds exactly one seeded working-capital loan: id 1, accountNo 000000001, clientId 5, externalId SEED-WC-L01, status loanStatusType.active. expect.loans[0].account_no="000000001" is the row's own "accountNo" field and expect.loans[0].client_id="5" its "clientId"; the other expect cells (id, external_id, status, total_elements) are the cells WC-01 already pins, re-pinned because the list comparator grades them on every list vector. No money cell is graded on this seam, so this vector records no rounding surface. WHAT THIS VECTOR DISCRIMINATES: the row carries BOTH the loan row's accountNo (000000001) and the borrowing client's clientAccountNo (000000005), so a list mapper that emits the client's account number for the loan row's own account_no (registered as workingcapital-wrong-list-row-mapping) goes red on account_no under this vector — WC-01, which pins no account cell, cannot see that transposition.

provenance.note: Every expect field is transcribed from the committed capture loans-list-raw.json; capture_case_id names the seeded loan row as observed in the list.
